SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(DDATE_STR,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'DD/MM/YYYY') DDATE_STR, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(get_ar_shiftno(#PERSON_ID#,to_char(AC.DDATE, 'yyyy/mm/dd'),AC.CPNY_ID),#interLanguage#) OVERTYPEID_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(SHIFT.SHIFT_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) SHIFT_NAME, GET_AR_ALL_DATETYPE(#supervisorPersonId:VARCHAR#,DDATE_STR,AC.CPNY_ID) DATE_TYPE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(GET_AR_ALL_DATETYPE(#supervisorPersonId:VARCHAR#,DDATE_STR,AC.CPNY_ID),#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DATE_NAME, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(GET_AR_SHIFT_START_TIME(#supervisorPersonId:VARCHAR#,DDATE_STR,AC.CPNY_ID),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') SHIFT_START_TIME, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(GET_AR_SHIFT_END_TIME(#supervisorPersonId:VARCHAR#,DDATE_STR,AC.CPNY_ID),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') SHIFT_END_TIME FROM AR_CALENDER AC,AR_SHIFT020 SHIFT WHERE GET_AR_SHIFTNO(#supervisorPersonId:VARCHAR#,DDATE_STR,CPNY_ID) = SHIFT.SHIFT_NO AND AC.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#
DDATE_STR >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#sDate:VARCHAR#,'DD/MM/YYYY'),'YYYY/MM/DD')
DDATE_STR <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#eDate:VARCHAR#,'DD/MM/YYYY'),'YYYY/MM/DD')
GROUP BY DDATE_STR,SHIFT.SHIFT_NO,AC.CPNY_ID,AC.OVERTYPEID,AC.DDATE ORDER BY DDATE_STR

SELECT HRE.LOCAL_NAME, HRE.EMPID, get_dept_name(HRE.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)DEPTNAME, get_global_name(HRE.POST_GRADE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)POST_GRADE, ARSM.PERSON_ID, ARSM.SHIFT_NO, get_global_name(ARSM.BEFOR_SHIFT_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)BEFOR_SHIFT_NO, get_global_name(ARSM.SHIFT_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) SHIFT_NAME , TO_CHAR(ARSM.START_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY')START_DATE, ARSM.REMARK, HRE.DEPTNO, ARSM.AR_SHIFTGROUP_MANAGE_NO, get_emp_local_name(ARSM.CREATED_BY,#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#) || ' '||ARSM.CREATED_IP CREATED_BY, TO_CHAR(ARSM.CREATE_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')CREATE_DATE FROM AR_SHIFTGROUP_MANAGEMENT ARSM,HR_EMPLOYEE HRE WHERE ARSM.PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID AND ARSM.ACTIVITY = 1 AND ARSM.PERSON_ID =#PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND HRE.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#
ARSM.START_DATE >= to_date(#sDate:VARCHAR#,'DD/MM/YYYY')
to_date(#eDate:VARCHAR#,'DD/MM/YYYY') >= ARSM.START_DATE
ARSM.START_DATE between to_date(#sDate:VARCHAR#,'DD/MM/YYYY') and to_date(#eDate:VARCHAR#,'DD/MM/YYYY')
ARSM.SHIFT_NO = #GROUOP_ID:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY ARSM.CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AR_CALENDER, (SELECT T1.SHIFT_NO SCHEDULE_SHIFT_NO, T1.AR_DATE_STR, T2.DATATYPE FROM AR_SCHEDULE_$CPNY_ID$ T1, AR_SHIFT010 T2 WHERE T1.SHIFT_NO = T2.SHIFT_NO AND T1.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#) T_SCHEDULE, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY3 WHERE AR_CALENDER.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND AR_CALENDER.DDATE = to_date(T_SCHEDULE.AR_DATE_STR(+),'yyyy-mm-dd') AND AR_CALENDER.TYPEID = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND AR_CALENDER.SHIFT_NO = SY2.NO(+) AND SY2.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T_SCHEDULE.DATATYPE = SY3.NO(+) AND SY3.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#
AR_CALENDER.DDATE between to_date(#sDate#,'YYYY/MM/DD') and to_date(#eDate#,'YYYY/MM/DD')
ORDER BY AR_CALENDER.DDATE
